events.title: A Shaun Goater double sees 맨체스터 시티 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 3–1 in the last Manchester derby at Maine Road . It is the first time since September 1989 that City have beaten United in a competitive game, and the first time since March 1993 that United have failed to beat City at Maine Road.
선덜랜드 achieve their first league win under Howard Wilkinson by beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–0 at the Stadium of Light .
Ruud van Nistelrooy scores a hat-trick as 맨체스터 유나이티드 end a dismal run of league form by beating 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 5–3 at Old Trafford.

As November draws to a close, 리버풀 are on a dismal run of form which has seen 아스널 overtake them into first place in the Premier League by a single point. 에버턴 are putting up a surprise title challenge after more than a decade of mediocrity as they occupy third place and are just three points off the top. 첼시 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 complete the top five. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 볼턴 원더러스 finish the month in the relegation zone. 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 continue to lead the way in Division One. 노팅엄 포리스트, 노리치 시티, Reading (newly promoted) and 셰필드 유나이티드 complete the top six.
